_about: Cost to serve ONE grant of a reward, by reward_kind. The proposer fills the required fields per idea; code fills the rest from these defaults and computes break_even_ecpm = 1000 * cost / views_per_grant (see bible/breakeven.py). Cases: favorable = cheapest plausible, central = default, unfavorable = most expensive plausible. Fields marked assumption:true have no source; they are stated so the app team can replace them.
formula: break_even_ecpm_usd = 1000 * reward_cost_usd / views_per_grant. Verdict: PASS if break-even(central) <= benchmark.low for the app's main region/platform; CONDITIONAL if break-even(favorable) <= benchmark.high; else FAIL.

sources.prices: favorable = DeepInfra Llama-3.3-70B-Turbo $0.10/$0.32 (E18); central = OpenAI gpt-5-mini $0.25/$2.00 (E05); unfavorable = Claude Haiku 4.5 $1/$5 (E01). All live pricing pages read 2026-09-27.
sources.tokens_in: assumption:true. No measured tokens-per-turn source for companion apps survived verification (E28/E29 failed). Central 4,000 = character definition + short recent history.

inference.note: Prompt caching cuts input cost ~90% on cache hits (E02, E05). If the app caches the character card, pass usd_per_mtok_in at the cached rate.

sources.prices: favorable = FLUX dev on fal.ai $0.025 (E21); central = Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite Image 1K $0.0336 (E13); unfavorable = Gemini 3.1 Flash Image 1K $0.067 (E12).
OpenAI tts-1 $15/1M chars (E09); ElevenLabs Flash $0.05 and v3 $0.10 per 1k chars (E22). Converted at 900 characters per spoken minute (assumption:true, ~150 words/min).

feature_time.cost_term: minutes * ads_per_minute * displaced_ecpm_usd / 1000  (ads the app no longer shows during an ad-free or premium window)

sources.displaced_ecpm_usd: favorable = NA Android banner $0.55 (D05); central = NA Android interstitial $9.70; unfavorable = NA iOS interstitial $13.60 (D04).
sources.ads_per_minute: assumption:true. Replace with the app's observed ad load from the product model.

feature_time.note: If the window unlocks a PAID feature rather than removing ads, use currency/cannibalization reasoning instead and say so.

sources.p_would_pay: central 0.02 from 'less than 2% of app users make in-app purchases' (Unity 2024 via Verve, D26, secondhand). favorable/unfavorable are assumption:true.
sources.displaced_ecpm_usd: web display CPM $1.42 / in-app $1.70 (D22, snippet-only, low confidence).

content_unlock.note: For ad-supported content (news, feeds) set ads_per_unit to the ads a page/episode would have carried. For paywalled content set unit_price_usd to the coin/IAP price of one unit.

currency.cost_term: amount * usd_per_unit * p_would_pay  (cannibalization: the chance the user would have bought it instead)
currency.note: usd_per_unit = the app's cheapest IAP price divided by the units it buys. If the currency is spent on inference (messages, images), cost it as inference/image, not currency.

queue_priority.cost_term: 0 marginal tokens; capacity cost at peak is real but unknown

category_cost_terms.ai_chat: inference (messages), image (generated images), voice (TTS minutes). The reward IS the cost.
category_cost_terms.content_news: displaced ad revenue (ads not shown) or a paid unlock given away (p_would_pay * price).
category_cost_terms.games: near 0 marginal cost; the risk is economy inflation and IAP cannibalization, not serving cost.
category_cost_terms.subscription_feature: cannibalization: value of the subscription benefit times the chance the user would have paid. Keep rewards partial and temporary.
